400.description: Invalid argument - The client specified an invalid argument

401.description: Unauthenticated - The request does not have valid authentication credentials

403.description: Permission denied - The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

409.description: Aborted - The operation was aborted due to concurrency issue

412.description: Failed precondition - Operation was rejected because the system is not in required state

413.description: Out of range - Operation was attempted past the valid range

429.description: Resource exhausted - Some resource has been exhausted (rate limiting)

431.description: Request header fields too large - Request metadata was too large

499.description: Cancelled - The operation was cancelled by the client

501.description: Unimplemented - The operation is not implemented or supported

503.description: Unavailable - The service is currently unavailable

504.description: Deadline exceeded - Upstream service did not respond in time

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThread.description: An execution thread within a `session`. Each session has one primary thread plus zero or more child threads spawned by the coordinator.

agent.name: Researcher
agent.system: You are a research subagent that gathers and summarises sources for the coordinating agent.

agent.description: Resolved agent definition for this thread. Snapshot of the agent at thread creation time.

examples.name: Researcher
examples.system: You are a research subagent that gathers and summarises sources for the coordinating agent.

archived_at.description: When the thread was archived. Null if not archived.

parent_thread_id.description: Parent thread that spawned this thread. Null for the primary thread.

session_id.description: The session this thread belongs to.

stats.description: Timing statistics for this thread. Null until the thread's first status transition.

status.description: Current execution status of the thread.

updated_at.description: When the thread was last updated.

usage.description: Cumulative token usage for this thread. Null until the thread's first idle transition.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStats.description: Timing statistics for a session thread.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds the thread spent actively running. Excludes idle time.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed time since thread creation in seconds. For archived threads, frozen at the final update.

startup_seconds.description: Time in seconds for the thread to begin running. Zero for child threads, which start immediately.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadUsage.description: Cumulative token usage for a session thread across all turns.

active_seconds.description: Cumulative time in seconds this thread spent in running status. Equal to `stats.active_seconds`; surfaced here so a thread's usage carries every quantity its cost is priced on.

cache_creation.description: Tokens used to create prompt cache entries, broken down by cache TTL.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Total tokens read from prompt cache.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens consumed across all turns.

list_cost.description: Cumulative list cost of this thread across all turns, priced at public list rates. Absent until cost tracking is available for the thread. Each figure is rounded to the nearest cent independently and the session's aggregate `usage.list_cost` additionally includes session runtime, so per-thread costs do not sum exactly to the session figure; the session figure is authoritative and is what a budget is enforced against.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens generated across all turns.

server_tool_use.description: Cumulative server-executed tool usage across all turns of this thread. Absent until server-tool tracking is available for the thread.

BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent.description: Resolved `agent` definition for a single `session_thread`. Snapshot of the agent at thread creation time. The multiagent roster is not repeated here; read it from `Session.agent`.

ephemeral_1h_input_tokens.description: Tokens used to create 1-hour ephemeral cache entries.

ephemeral_5m_input_tokens.description: Tokens used to create 5-minute ephemeral cache entries.

BetaMonetaryAmount.description: A monetary amount in a specific currency.

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the currency, as an integer decimal string with no leading zeros: "2500" is $25.00 and "50" is fifty cents. A string rather than a number so no float rounding is ever applied.

currency.description: Uppercase ISO-4217 currency code. `USD` is the only currency currently supported; the accepted set is closed and grows only when a new currency is priced.

BetaManagedAgentsServerToolUsage.description: Cumulative count of server-executed tool invocations, broken down by tool.

web_fetch_requests.description: Number of server-executed web fetch requests.

web_search_requests.description: Number of server-executed web search requests.

BetaManagedAgentsMCPServer.description: Union type for MCP server connection definitions returned in API responses.

effort.description: How hard Claude works on each inference call. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`. Always present; resolved to the per-model default at save time when not supplied.

inference_geo.description: Geographic region for model inference. When unset, requests fall through to the workspace's default_inference_geo.

speed.description: Inference speed mode. `fast` provides significantly faster output token generation at premium pricing. Defaults to `standard`. Not all models support `fast`; invalid combinations are rejected at create time.
